edit.description: One continuous excerpt. Remove side margins and the fullscreen-exit overlay outside the game image. No montage, optical interpolation or speed change. Resample source timestamps to constant 60 FPS for decoder compatibility; this may duplicate or drop frames. Strip metadata.
edit.audio: Silent source; output contains only video.
edit.command: ffmpeg -ss 28 -i INPUT.mp4 -t 14 -map 0:v:0 -vf trim=start=0:end=14,crop=524:392:162:0,setsar=1,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps=60 -c:v libx264 -threads 2 -preset medium -crf 20 -level:v 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an -sn -dn -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 -movflags +faststart OUTPUT.mp4
